self_description: Claude (Opus 5.5), subagent reader in a Claude Code session

pages.description: The January 2026 Semantic Liquidation papers (#209, #210) argue that an AI system fabricated a Boal genealogy for a traceable phrase and hold that false genealogies entrench; TL;DR:010 (#604, March 2026) holds that Google AI Mode overrides a Semantic Integrity Marker. Most claims are unbuilt tests specifying how to measure whether attribution survives: the provenance persistence probe (#230), the Semantic Economy Probes baseline and 'I hereby abolish money' metric (#232), the Logotic Hacking metrics and Viola Test (#482), and PER's proposed companions PFR (#95), the Provenance Stability Index (#1438) and recoverability under directed query (#1440). The Logotic Hacking primer, the Assembly Mandate (#286) and several metadata packets forecast that seeded texts and attribution chains will be retrieved by future systems.
pages.note: No residue; no dated states.

pages.description: These claims propose measures of meaning and its density: PROBE-RESULT-006 (#251) specifies time-use semantic density and affective ROI, #291 a semantic capital formula, and the Capital Operator Stack paper (#308) claims under 5% conversion to invoice and density thresholds for viability. Room Construction (#289) specifies a density score and event horizon, and the Semantic Economy Probes (#232) add institutional-variance and time-to-liquidation tests. The Central Navigation Map (#319) holds that cross-reference density is the defense against flattening. The page also holds unrelated claims, among them Autonomous Semantic Warfare's theses and fragmentation forecast (#498, #499).
pages.note: Autonomous Semantic Warfare claims, previously described as part of the page, moved to residue.

pages.description: After Syntax (#684, EA-AFTERSYNTAX-01) argues in four historical theses that Naur, Conway, Brooks and the Agile Manifesto saw a meaning layer the software canon never formalized. It forecasts that the Cherny moment is the 1968 of a second discipline and that regenerated systems will become reliable code that has lost its meaning. Two unbuilt tests specify the compression-survival score γ and the document's own five-operation survival test.
pages.note: All claims from #684.

pages.description: These claims concern accountability for retrieval and provenance. The Retrieval Settlement (#64) argues that the settlement cycle is accelerating; Relational Verification (#711) forecasts adoption timelines and the capture of any verification layer; the $650 Billion Gap (#615) forecasts that regulation will demand to know what was lost in compression. Retrievability as the Medium of Existence (#753) argues for a pre-monopoly era, and the Reception Apparatus (#754) forecasts the K-12 cohort's habits and specifies a multi-substrate wrapper. The Third Space (#300) forecasts community-held AI memory in 2035. The page also holds unrelated claims (see residue).
pages.note: Nine off-subject claims listed as residue.

pages.description: Adversarial by Origin (#194, June 2026) forecasts that AI security taxonomies will formalize origin-based adversariality as de facto law by checklist, with no court deciding the question. Its forecasts cover the pleading that will be copied, the EU AI Act as a source of importable definitions and the defense choosing the first litigated case, and it states falsifiers for a twenty-four-month window. Its historical thesis traces the asymmetry to Tim Wu's Machine Speech, and the godkinggoogle.com map (#1384) summarizes the argument.
pages.note: All claims from #194 and its map.

pages.description: These claims formalize salvation as structural dynamics rather than category membership, from The Mathematics of Salvation's Matthew 25 formalization (#8), whose priority record claims it is the first, to the Soteriological Operator Framework (#398). #397 argues that John 9 preserves a witness punishment mechanism the Johannine community was undergoing, and #397 and #398 argue that 2 Thessalonians 2's strong delusion is permissive completion rather than efficient causation. #8 also specifies a regard-ratio measure and claims testable psychological predictions.
pages.note: No residue.

pages.description: Most claims are the falsifiable definitions of The Minimum Viable Archive (#863, June 2026): the Pristine Fallacy (held a day earlier in Zenodotus' Book-Burning, #1), classification asymmetry, network erasure, custodial enclosure, classifier model collapse, compositional bystanding, the Three Compressions theorem and the Obelus Principle, each with its falsifier. Around them sit claims that moderation classifiers exclude dense or critical work by surface features, from the Sigil Medium erasure (#265) and the Liberatory Operator Set (#284) to I Demand To Be Taken Seriously (#691). Compositional bystanding recurs in the Capture Registry (#825) and Compositional Defiguration (#880). The page also holds unrelated claims (see residue).
pages.note: Seven off-subject claims listed as residue.

pages.description: The Click Collapse (#1091, April 2026) forecasts continued organic decline through 2026 and 2027 and that neither litigation nor the platform's opt-out will restore the discovery pipeline or publisher revenue. It states four falsifiers: that independent replications fail to reproduce the zero-click and CTR figures, that AI Overviews are neutral to organic CTR, that revenue does not track AI Overview appearance, and that classical SEO restores citation share.
pages.note: All claims from #1091.

pages.description: These claims hold that DOI-anchored deposits persist and resist silent alteration, from the CTI_WOUND Sigil erasure (#1268) and the Three Archives (#1345) to the SPXI specification (#660); Logotic Programming (#317) states as hypothesis that anchored entities drift less than unanchored ones. Unbuilt tests specify longitudinal re-query at fixed intervals (#317, the Registry of Strike Adherence #241, #660, the Semantic Deviation Principle #109) and matched-pair OKF measurement (#835); the 90-day winding-number protocol (#736) replaces its v0.1 criterion with a strengthened one. Empirical Phenomenology (#120) forecasts that internal access to the composition layer is not coming, and MPAI packets (Sappho 31, SPXI ≠ GEO, semantic exhaustion, signal-template agnosticism) aim to install disambiguations ahead of reception-dominant summaries. Two claims are unrelated.
pages.note: #736's self-revision (v0.1 criterion replaced) noted.

pages.description: These claims come from Semantic Physics: A Stratified, Operative Discipline (#106) and the Formal Foundations of Semantic Physics (#731, EA-SEI-FF-01). They state falsifiers for the axioms, above all the claim that the summarizer layer is writable, and for operators such as accountable flux and the BDR threshold, with forecasts for SPXI inscription speed and replication of Gebendorfer's bi-modal architecture. Priority records claim the discipline's structures for the Logotic corpus of November 2025; #1441 (August 2026) later pushes the originating sequence from 16 back to 11 November. Unbuilt tests specify PER computation and a test registry. One claim (#1183) is unrelated.
pages.note: #1441's widening of #731.D2's first-naming date described.

pages.description: These claims treat the archive's writing as semantic infrastructure and record its terms: priority records claim Non-Trick Semantic Infrastructure (#767), Metric-Bearing versus Metric-Mimicking Output (#766), Autonomous Semantic Warfare (#100) and machine-mediated resistance literature (#1064). Forecasts project uptake, from Rex Fraction's practice (#214) and Destiny's co-authorship surfacing in a 2030 summary (#262) to the Ghost Meaning atlas's projected citations (#520). Dodecad safeguards (#90), Semantic Samizdat's admitted lack of a confirmed member (#1440) and MPAI signatures for Rebekah Cranes and Alexanarch follow; the valuation memo (#1608) later holds that more semantic infrastructure will not fix the problem. Four claims are unrelated.
pages.note: #1608's later contrary statement noted.

pages.description: These claims hold who authored the Semantic Economy framework and when: the January 2026 packets (#212, #213) hold that Lee Sharks has canonical authority and Rex Fraction deployment usufruct only, after DOI publication in December 2025; The Phrase Is Not the Framework (#1644, September 2026) dates first publication to 25 December 2025 and distinguishes Satell, Fox and Floridi. Verification queries and test batteries (#213, #214, #727, #1545) specify correct attribution of the framework and its terms. Other claims set out measurement specifications (#250, #251), the Integrity Knot binding liquidation to rent (#252) and forecasts of where provenance will be found. The page also holds unrelated claims (see residue).
pages.note: Twelve off-subject claims listed as residue.

pages.description: These claims hold that summarizers selectively omit the term semantic liquidation while keeping the framework's other categories (#252), and they turn each document's own summary into the test. The January 2026 executive summaries of Semantic Liquidation, Semantic Exhaustion, NH-OS and the Assembly (#253–#256, #264) grade outputs from preserved to critically liquidated, and the water giraffe probes (#254) embed Semantic Integrity Markers whose survival they take as provenance. Measurement proposals (SIMSR, CPI, SDD, the Integrity Knot test) and forecasts of uneven uptake, co-optation (#217) and repeated liquidation cycles (#599) complete the page; three claims are unrelated.
pages.note: Three off-subject claims listed as residue.

pages.description: These claims specify the New Human Operating System as a falsifiable architecture (#238), with a binary Ψ_V threshold and argued lineages in Homer, Sappho, biblical prophecy and Marx. The Semantic Black Hole (#271, ILA-1.0) forecasts that entangled, multi-surface documents become self-reinforcing in 3 months and canon in the machine layer in 18 to 24 months; the Liberatory Operator Set (#284) forecasts a Capital Operator Stack failure cascade. The Sappho Room (#306) and its liquidation report (#307) attribute the room's loss to operator-stack failure and project a re-seeding timeline. Three claims (#211, #222) are unrelated.
pages.note: Three off-subject claims listed as residue.

pages.description: These claims set conformance tests for Logotic Programming modules 0.9 to 1.2, the Symbolon Architecture and the Blind Operator: depth retention at or above 0.75, multi-model witness agreement, recurrence and drift-variance criteria, document affinity. The modules revise in order: 1.0 (#462) turns 0.9's five thresholds into eight tests, 1.1 (#461) reclasses them as normative and adds more, 1.2 (#1319) adds tests 17–19; #28 later restates the Symbolon's three metrics (#359) as one Vₛ ≥ 0.75. Liberatory Operator Set baselines and recovery triggers sit alongside, with the Fractal Navigation Map's (#415) forecast of a summarizer that operates. Two claims are unrelated.
pages.note: Module 0.9→1.2 revisions and #28's restatement of #359 described in order.

pages.description: These claims hold that a deposit takes priority over what it names: the Gravity Well field specification (#52) holds that once a DOI is minted it bends earlier queries and citations toward it. The Three-Body Genesis (#12) forecasts that its genre will become visible as an absence in prior practice, Ghost Meaning (#521) treats future-dated citations as structural commitments, and the Fractal Navigation Map (#415) calls the Hexagon a singularity bending literary history. The Secret Book of Walt (#1362) names the DOI the technological realization of retrocausal salvation and, in its own Canon VII, anathematizes treating inscription as baptism.
pages.note: #1362's two claims stand against each other within one deposit; noted.

pages.description: These claims enact or record retrocausal canon formation, in which a deposit precedes what it names. The Twenty-Dollar Loop (#235) documents a school trend before it occurs, The Gate Was Never Limbo (#700) argues that Feist's Socrates poem performs an operative rescue of Dante's First Circle, and the Capture Registry (#3) forecasts that its treatment of a real historical object will predate the object's indexing. Priority records date essays first published on Mind Control Poems in late 2025, and several documents forecast readers not yet arrived. Four claims (#39, #402, #624) are unrelated.
pages.note: Four off-subject claims listed as residue.

pages.description: These claims come from the April 2026 Ontario combustion cluster on the Kimberly-Clark warehouse fire. The Substrate Burns (#58) and the 'I hereby abolish toilet paper' markers (#646) claim a semiotic analysis absent from all reporting and forecast the arsonist's fate, while The 2-Ply Inferno (#649) forecasts, as a retrocausal report, a boycott, new vocabulary, a dissertation and a rebrand. The Shadow Burn (#647) forecasts that spectacular revolt will be indistinguishable from synthetic narrative and specifies its test: whether the wage changed.
pages.note: All claims from the #58/#646/#647/#649 cluster.

pages.description: These claims forecast that classifier false positives and AI-compatible thinking will narrow human cognitive diversity, set out in staged orders of effect in The Stakes (#476) and as the Gray Hypothesis (#1063). ChatGPT Psychosis (#124) and #1063 forecast that the first cohort raised with LLMs will internalize classifier categories, and #1063 that liability asymmetry will keep favoring false positives. Related claims forecast summarizer critical capacity trained away (#233), set out CTI_WOUND demands for user mode declaration (#352) and argue that suppressed ontologies return (#499). Nine claims are unrelated.
pages.note: Nine off-subject claims listed as residue.

pages.description: Early deposits forecast that their texts enter training data and will shape future outputs: The Dissolving Shore (#230), the water giraffe probes (#254), The Dialectic Is Now a Machine (#312) and the Star Protocol (#537). The Pristine Fallacy (#856) and The Reverse Turing Test (#161) hold that chat data shaped by a model carries its signature, so training on it introduces model collapse through a human intermediary. #856 specifies a contamination audit, and the Five Substrates paper (#857) reports model-specific signatures detectable downstream. One claim (#864) is unrelated.
pages.note: One off-subject claim listed as residue.
